verses.zh: 以色列的儿子是流便、西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦、
verses.en: These were the sons of Israel:[NOTE:1] Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah; Issachar and Zebulun;
notes: The groupings in the list that follows, as well as the conjunctions (vav-consecutives in Hebrew), reflect those of the Hebrew text.

verses.zh: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
verses.en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin; Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉，这三人是迦南人书亚女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就使他死了。
verses.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bathshua,[NOTE:1] a Canaanite woman. Er, Judah’s firstborn, displeased the Lord, so the Lord killed him.[NOTE:2]
notes: The name means “daughter of Shua.” Shua is identified in Gen 38:2 as a “Canaanite man.”
Heb “was evil in the eyes of the Lord, so he [i.e., the Lord] killed him [i.e., Er].”

verses.zh: 犹大的儿妇她玛给犹大生法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。
verses.en: Tamar, Judah’s[NOTE:1] daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
notes: Heb “his”; the referent (Judah) has been specified in the translation for clarity.

verses.zh: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑、哈母勒。
verses.en: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.zh: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉（就是达大），共五人。
verses.en: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol, Dara[NOTE:1]—five in all.
notes: Many medieval Hebrew mss, some LXX mss, and Syriac read “Darda” (see 1 Kgs 4:31 ET = 1 Kgs 5:11 HT).

verses.zh: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。
verses.en: The son[NOTE:1] of Carmi: Achan,[NOTE:2] who brought the disaster on Israel when he stole what was devoted to God.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “sons.” The Hebrew text has the plural, but only one son is listed.
The Hebrew text has “Achar,” which means “disaster,” but a few medieval Hebrew mss read “Achan.” See Josh 7:1.
Heb “the troubler of Israel who was unfaithful with respect to the devoted [things].”

verses.zh: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。
verses.en: The son[NOTE:1] of Ethan: Azariah.
notes: Heb “sons.” The Hebrew text has the plural, but only one son is listed.

verses.zh: 希斯仑所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰、基路拜。
verses.en: The sons born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.[NOTE:1]
notes: The Hebrew text has “Celubai,” but see v. 18, where Caleb is described as the son of Hezron.

verses.zh: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺。拿顺作犹大人的首领。
verses.en: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, the tribal chief of Judah.

verses.zh: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯；
verses.en: Nahshon was the father of Salma,[NOTE:1] and Salma was the father of Boaz.
notes: The LXX reads “Salmon” (cf. Ruth 4:21) and is followed by some English versions (e.g., NIV, NCV, TEV, NLT).

verses.zh: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
verses.en: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.

verses.zh: 耶西生长子以利押，次子亚比拿达，三子示米亚（示米亚就是沙玛，见撒母耳上十六章九节），
verses.en: Jesse was the father of Eliab, his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,

verses.zh: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，
verses.en: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,

verses.zh: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。
verses.en: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.

verses.zh: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押、亚撒黑，共三人。
verses.en: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah’s three sons were Abshai,[NOTE:1] Joab, and Asahel.
notes: In 2 Sam 2:18 this name appears as “Abishai,” a spelling followed by many English versions here.

verses.zh: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。
verses.en: Abigail bore Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

verses.zh: 希斯仑的儿子迦勒娶阿苏巴和耶略为妻，阿苏巴的儿子是耶设、朔罢、押墩。
verses.en: Caleb son of Hezron fathered sons by his wife Azubah (also known as Jerioth).[NOTE:1] Her sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
notes: Heb “and Caleb son of Hezron fathered [children] with Azubah, a wife, and with Jerioth.” Jerioth could be viewed as a second wife (so NLT; cf. also NASB, NIV, NRSV), but the following context mentions only “her [presumably Azubah’s] sons.” Another option, the one chosen in the translation, is that Jerioth is another name for Azubah.

verses.zh: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法他，生了户珥。
verses.en: When Azubah died, Caleb married[NOTE:1] Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
notes: Heb “took for himself.”

verses.zh: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。
verses.en: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

verses.zh: 希斯仑正六十岁娶了基列父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房；玛吉的女儿生了西割；
verses.en: Later[NOTE:1] Hezron slept with[NOTE:2] the daughter of Makir, the father of Gilead. (He had married[NOTE:3] her when he was sixty years old.) She bore him Segub.
notes: This means “later” in relation to the births of the three sons (Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb) mentioned in v. 9.
The expression בּוֹא אֶל (boʾ ʾel) means “come to” or “approach,” but is also used as a euphemism for sexual relations.
Heb “he took,” referring to taking in marriage.

verses.zh: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三个城邑。
verses.en: Segub was the father of Jair, who owned twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

verses.zh: 后来基述人和亚兰人夺了睚珥的城邑，并基纳和其乡村，共六十个。这都是基列父亲玛吉之子的。
verses.en: (Geshur and Aram captured the towns of Jair,[NOTE:1] along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding towns.) All these were descendants of Makir, the father of Gilead.
notes: Or “Havvoth Jair” (NIV, NRSV). Some translations do not translate the phrase (“havvoth” = “the towns of”), but treat it as part of the place name.

verses.zh: 希斯仑在迦勒・以法他死后，他的妻亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。
verses.en: After Hezron’s death, Caleb slept with Ephrath, his father Hezron’s widow, and she bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “And after the death of Hezron in Caleb Ephrathah, and the wife of Hezron, Abijah, and she bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.” The translations assumes three diferences from the MT. 1) Where the MT preserves only the preposition ב (bet, “in”), the NET agrees with the text behind the LXX and Vulgate in reading בָּא ב (baʾ b-, “went to”). Caleb is thus the subject of the verb rather than an otherwise unattested place name, and Ephrath(a) is a reference to his wife (see vv. 19 and 50). A directional he on the end of Ephratha would be unusual on a personal name but the he also appears in v. 50 where it cannot be a directional he. Also the phrase בָּא ב is viewed as a euphemism for sexual relations, rather than a description of entering the town of Ephrath (or Bethlehem). 2) The ו (vav, “and”) is not read before “wife of Hezron.” 3) A ו (vav) is restored after אֲבִיָּה (ʾaviyyah, “Abijah”) to make אָבִיהוּ (ʾavihu, “his father”). This less common form of the noun with the suffix also occurs in 1 Chron 26:10 and 2 Chron 3:1. Thus “the wife of Hezron his father” is a descriptor of Caleb’s second wife, Ephrath. Some translations follow the MT on the first point to make Abijah the subject of the following verb as in “after Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore to him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa” (cf. NASB, NIV, NRSV). However, the preterite verb form cannot properly be preceded by its subject in this fashion. One would need to suppose that the phrase “and the wife of Hezron, Abijah” is not appositional but rather a parenthetic clause “and the wife of Hezron was Abijah.” R. Braun (1 Samuel [WBC], 40) is favorable to the idea that “the name of Hezron’s wife represents a misplaced gloss on v 21” (citing Williamson, JBL 98, 355). In the reading adopted here, this would mean that Caleb’s second wife, Ephrath, had actually been his late father’s wife (probably Caleb’s stepmother). Perhaps the text was subsequently altered because Caleb’s actions appeared improper in light of the injunctions in Lev 18:8; 20:11; Deut 22:30; 27:20 (which probably refer, however, to a son having sexual relations with his stepmother while his father is still alive).

verses.zh: 希斯仑的长子耶拉篾生长子兰，又生布拿、阿连、阿鲜、亚希雅。
verses.en: The sons of Jerahmeel, Hezron’s firstborn, were Ram, the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

verses.zh: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亚她拉，是阿南的母亲。
verses.en: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah; she was Onam’s mother.

verses.zh: 耶拉篾长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯、以结。
verses.en: The sons of Ram, Jerahmeel’s firstborn, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

verses.zh: 阿南的儿子是沙买、雅大。沙买的儿子是拿答、亚比述。
verses.en: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada.The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

verses.zh: 亚比述的妻名叫亚比孩，亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。
verses.en: Abishur’s wife was Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

verses.zh: 拿答的儿子是西列、亚遍；西列死了没有儿子。
verses.en: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. (Seled died without having sons.)

verses.zh: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。
verses.en: The son[NOTE:1] of Appaim: Ishi.The son of Ishi: Sheshan.The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
notes: Heb “sons.” The Hebrew text has the plural “sons” in all three instances in this verse, even though the following lists have only one name each.

verses.zh: 沙买兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖、约拿单；益帖死了没有儿子。
verses.en: The sons of Jada, Shammai’s brother: Jether and Jonathan. (Jether died without having sons.)

verses.zh: 约拿单的儿子是比勒、撒萨。这都是耶拉篾的子孙。
verses.en: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza.These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

verses.zh: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿。示珊有一个仆人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
verses.en: Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. Sheshan had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

verses.zh: 示珊将女儿给了仆人耶哈为妻，给他生了亚太。
verses.en: Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha as a wife; she bore him Attai.

verses.zh: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔；
verses.en: Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad.

verses.zh: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得；
verses.en: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed.

verses.zh: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅；
verses.en: Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah.

verses.zh: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨；
verses.en: Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah.

verses.zh: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙；
verses.en: Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum.

verses.zh: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。
verses.en: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

verses.zh: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的长子米沙，是西弗之祖玛利沙的儿子，是希伯仑之祖。
verses.en: The sons of Caleb, Jerahmeel’s brother: his firstborn Mesha, the father of Ziph, and his second son Mareshah,[NOTE:1] the father of Hebron.
notes: Heb “and the sons of Mareshah,” but this does not fit contextually. Perhaps the text originally had וּבְנוֹ מִשְׁנֶה מָרֵשָׁה (uveno mishneh mareshah, “and his second son, Mareshah”), with מִשְׁנֶה (“second”) later accidentally falling out by homoioteleuton (cf. the note in BHS here).

verses.zh: 希伯仑的儿子是可拉、他普亚、利肯、示玛。
verses.en: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

verses.zh: 示玛生拉含，是约干之祖。利肯生沙买。
verses.en: Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

verses.zh: 沙买的儿子是玛云；玛云是伯・夙之祖。
verses.en: Shammai’s son was Maon, who was the father of Beth Zur.

verses.zh: 迦勒的妾以法生哈兰、摩撒、迦谢；哈兰生迦卸。
verses.en: Caleb’s concubine[NOTE:1] Ephah bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
notes: See the note on the word “concubine” in 1:32.

verses.zh: 〈雅代的儿子是利健、约坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亚弗。〉
verses.en: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.zh: 迦勒的妾玛迦生示别、特哈拿，
verses.en: Caleb’s concubine Maacah bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

verses.zh: 又生麦玛拿之祖沙亚弗、抹比拿和基比亚之祖示法。迦勒的女儿是押撒。
verses.en: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Achsah.

verses.zh: 迦勒的子孙就是以法他的长子、户珥的儿子，记在下面：基列・耶琳之祖朔巴，
verses.en: These were the descendants of Caleb.The sons[NOTE:1] of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrath:[NOTE:2] Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim,
notes: Heb “son.” The Hebrew text has the singular, but the following list contains more than one name.
The Hebrew text reads “Ephrathah” here, but see v. 19, which mentions “Ephrath” as the wife of Caleb and mother of Hur.

verses.zh: 伯利恒之祖萨玛，伯迦得之祖哈勒。
verses.en: Salma, the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the father of Beth Gader.

verses.zh: 基列・耶琳之祖朔巴的子孙是哈罗以和一半米努・哈人（米努・哈人就是玛拿哈人）。
verses.en: The sons of Shobal, the father of Kiriath Jearim, were Haroeh, half the Manahathites,[NOTE:1]
notes: The Hebrew text has “Menuchites” here, but v. 54 has “Manachathites.”

verses.zh: 基列・耶琳的诸族是以帖人、布特人、舒玛人、密来人，又从这些族中生出琐拉人和以实陶人来。
verses.en: the clans of Kiriath Jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. (The Zorathites and Eshtaolites descended from these groups.)[NOTE:1]
notes: Heb “from these went forth the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.”

verses.zh: 萨玛的子孙是伯利恒人、尼陀法人、亚他绿・伯・约押人、一半玛拿哈人、琐利人，
verses.en: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

verses.zh: 和住雅比斯众文士家的特拉人、示米押人、苏甲人。这都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
verses.en: and the clans of the scribes[NOTE:1] who lived in Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who descended[NOTE:2] from Hammath, the father of Beth Rechab.[NOTE:3]
notes: Or perhaps “the Sopherim.” The NAB transliterates this term and treats it as a proper name.
Heb “came.”
Or (if בֵּית [beth] is translated as “house” rather than considered to be part of the name) “the father of the house [i.e., family] of Rechab.”
